verdict.rationale: Resend documents an official CLI: llms.txt says to "Install and use the Resend CLI from the terminal," and a probe confirms the official repo at github.com/resend/resend-cli. The changelog and docs show CLI coverage for domain verification, segment renaming, and webhook management. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage, and documentation of agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install and use the Resend CLI from the terminal.
Rename a segment from the API, CLI, or any official SDK.
Build custom headless webhook experiences from the API, SDKs, CLI, and MCP server.
